name: kyrr
author: heast13
description: kyrr in the bar: local noise suppression, dictation and voice memos, free and offline. The menu is all of kyrr, walked with the keyboard; it installs kyrr when it is missing.

barWidget.description: Shows when kyrr listens, writes or records. Click: kyrr's menu with every switch and setting, the recordings and the first-run setup (arrows, Enter, Esc). Middle click: dictate.
